title: When every rand has a job to do, what makes a brand worth choosing?
discussion_signal: Kantar’s discussion describes tighter budgets, fluid choice, shifting loyalty, and AI, media, and digital behaviours reshaping brand decisions. It treats consumer agency and value as broader than price alone.
linked_research_question: How are consumers seeking agency over algorithms, institutions, leisure, health, and local culture while adopting AI on their own terms?
limits: The post is a market-research and brand discussion, not household microdata
It does not establish how agency varies by income or place
Commercial framing may foreground choice and understate structural constraints
